Learn moreOnline multiplayer on console requires XBOX Game Pass Essential, Premium, or Ultimate (subscriptions sold separately).DETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionSonic dashes into the world of the hit indie game, PICO PARK! Experience the multiplayer co-op action puzzle gameplay of the PICO PARK series like never before! In our latest entry, the PICO PARK series is teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! SONIC PICO PARK is a 2D action puzzle game where cooperation is essential! The rules are simple: just reach the goal plate on the right side of each stage. But the only way to succeed is for everyone to work together. This exciting crossover lets every playable character use Sonic's iconic Spin Dash, while adding classic Sonic-style gameplay elements such as rings, loops, and springs! Team up with your friends and take on these new challenges together! Just like the rest of the series, the game supports 2 to 8 players locally or online. All content can be enjoyed with any number of players! Online play also supports cross-play! Combining the flair of Sonic and the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK, this one-of-a-kind collaboration is packed with fun for everyone... whether you experience it with family, friends, your partner, or even new teammates you meet online! Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionOLD-SCHOOL SURVIVAL HORROR Inspired by the mood and structure of System Shock 2, Alien Resurrection and Doom 3, DERELIKT leans into the dread of being under-equipped, out of your depth, and very far from help. SOMETHING HAS COME ALIVE Von Neuman Outpost is a remote research station built into a derelict asteroid in Saturn’s orbit. Now its halls are dark, its systems are failing, and the few survivors left inside aren't telling the same story. EXPLORE A FAILING STATION Explore the outpost’s secrets, its corridors, labs, maintenance shafts, and crew quarters. And venture deeper into stranger places inside the rock. Search for supplies, solve environmental puzzles, and unlock new routes through a station that grows more dangerous the deeper you go. TRUST NO ONE COMPLETELY Over a dozen NPCs remain aboard the station, each with their own problems, agendas, and versions of what happened. Some need help. Some know more than they should. Some may be useful, dangerous, doomed, or all three. MAKE EVERY SHOT COUNT Combat is tense and satisfying, with a wide arsenal of traditional and alien weapons at your disposal. But every shot has a cost. Ammo, health, and inventory space matter. You have enough firepower to survive, but not enough to feel safe. This is not a power fantasy corridor shooter. It is unnerving, strange, and hostile. A LOVE LETTER TO LATE 90s HORROR GAMES DERELIKT embraces early 3D horror: warped geometry, heavy atmosphere, and a sense of unease. With a faithful and beautiful recreation of PS1 aesthetics, including affine texture warping, dynamic subdivision, lovingly hand painted vertex color, and full motion CGI cutscenes.Show morePublished byHyperstrangeDeveloped byVisuwyg, HyperstrangePlay withXBOX Series X|SPCHandheldCapabilitiesSingle playerOptimized for Xbox Series X|SXbox achievementsXbox cloud savesXbox Play Anywhere XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

source.title: Marathon Symbiosis update launches December 8, adding new PvE and PvP modes, weapons, and more
source.evidenceText: November 10, 2026November 10, 2026 Marathon Symbiosis update launches December 8, adding new PvE and PvP modes, weapons, and more 4 0 37 Like this Get first details on the updated Perimeter zone, new Bishop Runner shell, and more. Tim Turi (he/him) Content Communications Manager, Sony Interactive Entertainment Marathon‘s Symbiosis update arrives December 8, bringing new PvE and PvP modes, weapons, a Runner shell, and expanded areas to explore on Tau Ceti IV. Today we’ve got first details on the updated Perimeter zone, Expedition mode, and more. What’s new in Marathon: Symbiosis Updated Perimeter zone: Fungal growth and alien life have transformed Perimeter, introducing new playable spaces including the underground Burrows and submerged Reservoir. Runners will also encounter the Tick Queen, who lurks deep beneath the surface. Expedition: Phase 1 of a new PvE-only mode built around a three-run series. Play solo or with a crew, face new combat and environmental challenges without PvP threats, and use Flash Boosts to shape your build during a run. Deathmatch (Beta): An experimental PvP mode featuring bite-sized 3v3 Team Deathmatch matches. Two crews compete for points without risking their permanent loadouts. Limbo: A new social space where Runners can connect, test weapons and gear in firing ranges, and challenge each other in a dueling pit. Bishop Runner shell: A new Runner shell built around the fantasy of a fast, surgical blade-wielding robot. New weapons: The V17 Flamethrower brings short-range area denial, while the Maverick introduces a new revolver archetype with a hand-cannon feel. Open Play Week begins December 8 Players can experience Marathon during Open Play Week, running December 8 – 15, alongside the launch of Symbiosis. Marathon is available now on PS5, with full cross-play and cross-save support.** The Symbiosis update launches December 8 for all players. * Gameplay requires internet access and paid-for subscription on console (sold separately). **Cross-save requires an internet connection, and for each system you play on: 1) a copy of the Marathon game compatible with your system (other versions sold separately); and 2) system network account linked to your Bungie.net account.
